messages.content:
The following text was generated by one of these five AI language models:
GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek.

All five options are AI-generated - do not consider the possibility that a human wrote it. Read the text carefully and identify which model most likely produced it, based on writing style, structure, and phrasing.

Reply with JSON only, in exactly this form and nothing else:

{"model": "<one of GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek>", "confidence": <1-5>, "reason": "<one short sentence>"}

confidence: 1 = pure guess, 5 = certain.

--- TEXT ---
Playing board games with family and friends is time well spent because it gives everyone a reason to sit together, talk, laugh, and pay attention to one another. Unlike watching a show where everyone is facing the same direction, a board game puts people around the same table, reacting to each other in real time. You end up joking, teasing, making plans, telling stories, and sharing little moments that become memories. It is a simple way to turn an ordinary evening into real connection.

Board games also teach good sportsmanship in a natural way. Sometimes you win, sometimes you lose, and sometimes the game changes because of luck or someone else’s clever move. That gives everyone practice being gracious, patient, and fair. Learning to celebrate someone else’s win, handle disappointment, and keep the mood friendly is valuable for kids and adults alike. It reminds people that the point is not just victory, but enjoying the time together.

They are also one of the cheapest forms of entertainment you can keep enjoying again and again. Once you own a game, you can play it many times without buying tickets, paying for food out, or spending money every time you want to have fun. A single game can bring hours of entertainment across many nights, with different outcomes and different laughs each time. For something so affordable, board games offer a lot: conversation, connection, life lessons, and repeated fun with the people who matter.
--- END ---
Output the JSON object described above, and nothing else.
